clipboardDenied: The browser denied clipboard access. Check that you are using HTTPS.
tooManyChecks: Four proxies are already being checked. Please try again later.
poolSettingsDescription: Binding limits, automatic probes, exit DNS, and timezone following apply to the entire proxy pool.
addProxyDescription: Configure a proxy exit or use Quick add for bulk import.
unbindConfirm: {{p0}} will be unable to forward after unbinding. Continue?
tcpOnlyHint: Tests SOCKS TCP only; does not contact Anthropic
geoAllHint: Check the exit IP country, city, and timezone through each proxy
name: Name
nameExample: For example, Tokyo-2 or a data center name
localEditHint: You can edit the name and enabled state. No host, port, or credentials are needed. Local direct connections have no expiry or expiry fallback.
credentialsHint: Credentials are not displayed. Leave empty to keep existing values.
domainForwarding: Domain forwarding (CONNECT by hostname for IPv6-only exits; no IPv4 fallback)
parseProxyFailed: Could not parse proxy address. Check the protocol, host, and port.
protocolHint: HTTP / HTTPS use CONNECT tunnels; HTTPS verifies the proxy certificate. SOCKS5 resolves DNS locally, while SOCKS5H resolves it through the proxy.
importPlaceholder:
One proxy per line, for example:
http://proxy.example.com:8080
https://user:pass@proxy.example.com:443
socks5://user:pass@192.0.2.1:1080
socks5h://user:pass@proxy.example.com:1080
importHint: Supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, and SOCKS5H. Addresses without a scheme use SOCKS5 (host:port or host:port:user:pass). Duplicate protocol, address, and credentials are removed automatically.
validityPlaceholder: Custom days; leave empty for no expiry
expiryHint: Expires at the end of this date in the browser's local timezone. Leave empty for no expiry.
noFallback: No fallback (pause scheduling for associated VMs)
switchLocalDirect: Switch to the server's local direct exit
fallbackHint: Bound VMs switch automatically on expiry. Scheduling stays paused if the target is unavailable or full. Renewing does not switch back automatically.
filterNodesPlaceholder: Filter available nodes: address, name, slot, country, or timezone
noAvailableNodeMatches: No matching available nodes (full, disabled, or invalid nodes are excluded).
noProxies: No proxies yet. Use Add proxy at the top right to import SOCKS5 lines or add a local proxy.
credentialsNotShown: Credentials are hidden from the list. Copy retrieves them on demand directly to the clipboard.
toggleSort: Sort by {{p0}}, currently {{p1}}; click to reverse
dnsSaved: Exit DNS saved; local exit synchronized
overCapacityHint: {{p0}} proxies exceed {{p1}} slots. Existing bindings stay; no new slots are accepted.
lowerLimitHint: Lowering the limit does not remove existing bindings.
dnsFallbackHint: Try the next server on failure
dohUrlRequired: Enter a complete HTTPS DoH URL, such as https://dns.example.com/dns-query
dohUrlHint: Enter a complete HTTPS URL with a domain or IP (enclose IPv6 in brackets). Usernames, passwords, fragments (#), and commas are not allowed.
disableDnsTypesHint: Override SVCB (64) and HTTPS (65) with empty DNS answers; A / AAAA are unaffected. Applies only to SOCKS5 exits. Cluster exits update on the next slot start or reload.
pinnedTimezoneHint: Slots with manually pinned timezones are unaffected
regionFilterHint: {{p0}}: proxies {{p1}}, free seats {{p2}} under current filters. Click to filter this region.
emptyPoolHint: No proxies in the pool. Each imported proxy gets a column, with one dot per allowed binding.
dragBindHint: Drag onto a table row to bind; bound slots can also be moved to another proxy
dragToBind: Drag onto a table row to bind
qualityReportHint: Tests target reachability through the selected exit. Expected responses such as 401/405 confirm network access, not account authorization or model availability.
basicConnectivityFailed: Basic connectivity failed, so target services were not tested. Score: 0.
bindReloadFailed: {{done}}. The slot could not reload; scheduling is paused. Fix the issue and resume scheduling manually.
nodeConnecting: Node connection is being established. Try again shortly.
localExitReady: Local exit is ready. Use the quality check to verify internet reachability.
probeInProgress: The previous probe is still running. Refresh later for results.
disableUnboundConfirm: This proxy will stop accepting new slots. Disable it?
testConnectionHint: Send a network probe through this exit to check connectivity, authentication, and exit IP
qualityCheckHint: Check basic connectivity and OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Grok through this exit
expiryBackupSuffix: · switch to backup proxy on expiry
expiryDirectSuffix: · switch to local direct on expiry
fullNoNewSlots: Full; not accepting new slots. Drag a slot to another proxy row to move it.
boundReloadHint_other: This proxy has {{count}} bound slots. Saving will reload their workers.
boundReloadHint_one: This proxy has {{count}} bound slot. Saving will reload its worker.
localBindingHint: · {{label}}: {{exit}}; binding capacity is counted separately for this VPS
disableBoundConfirm_other: Disabling will pause scheduling for all {{count}} bound slots until this proxy is enabled again. Disable?
disableBoundConfirm_one: Disabling will pause scheduling for the {{count}} bound slot until this proxy is enabled again. Disable?
deleteBoundConfirm_other: Deleting will unbind all {{count}} slots and pause scheduling. They must be rebound to a proxy to resume. Delete?
deleteBoundConfirm_one: Deleting will unbind the {{count}} slot and pause scheduling. It must be rebound to a proxy to resume. Delete?
dnsSavedReloadFailed_other: DNS saved, but {{count}} exits failed to reload: {{p1}}
dnsSavedReloadFailed_one: DNS saved, but {{count}} exit failed to reload: {{p1}}
mostBoundHint_other: Highlighted cells show the busiest proxy ({{count}} slots).
mostBoundHint_one: Highlighted cells show the busiest proxy ({{count}} slot).
seatMapHint_other: {{p0}} · probe every {{count}} minutes · one dot per seat; click a region to filter or a column to locate its row
seatMapHint_one: {{p0}} · probe every {{count}} minute · one dot per seat; click a region to filter or a column to locate its row
qualityExitUnavailable: Unable to obtain connectivity information through this exit
qualityRateLimited: Target returned 429; rate limiting may be active
qualityConnectionFailed: Connectivity check failed. Check the exit, target service, and raw diagnostic.
bindReloadFailedReason: {{done}}. The slot could not reload ({{reason}}); scheduling is paused. Fix the issue and resume scheduling manually.
